scheme_name: Distress Relief Fund For The Differently Abled (Medical Treatment)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Applicant must be a disabled person or have become handicapped due to an accident
Annual income must not exceed ₹20,000 in rural areas or ₹22,375 in urban areas
Disability categories include blind, deaf and dumb, orthopedically handicapped, mentally challenged, or BPL with at least 40% disability
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 per person per year for medical treatment, including surgery.
